text:
```yaml
name: Security Scan

on:
  push:
    branches: [ "main" ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ "main" ]
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 10 * * *'

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  security:
    name: Security Scan
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Harden Runner
        uses: step-security/harden-runner@20cf305ff2072d973412fa9b1e3a4f227bda3c76
        with:
          egress-policy: audit

      - name: Checkout Code
        uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683

      - name: Run Trivy vulnerability scanner
        uses: aquasecurity/trivy-action@master
        with:
          scan-type: 'image'
          image-ref: 'ghcr.io/traceloop/opentelemetry-mcp-server:latest'
          exit-code: '1'
          ignore-unfixed: true
          vuln-type: 'os,library'
          severity: 'CRITICAL,HIGH,MEDIUM'
```
